title: Clarify Accounts sign-in and restore actionable controls
description: Given a signed-in user reaches Accounts before the current login has canonical identity confirmation, when the view is displayed, then it explains the required Google confirmation without implying a service failure. Controls must be visibly interactive, prevent duplicate connection submissions, expose progress and errors, and ordinary explanatory text must remain selectable. Preserve issuer/subject/nonce verification and create no memberships or administrative grants. Reproduce the session behavior and document the administrative-directory scope mismatch before redesign.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented scoped confirmation copy, selectable explanatory text, styled controls and duplicate-submission protection. Production build and synthetic browser regression pass. Existing session-confirmation behavior reproduced live. Broader directory scope mismatch is documented privately for product coordination; this change does not expand access.
